title: Bricks
tagline: Bricks is a solution to mint fractional NFTs using decentralised governance.
description:
Bricks is an open source solution to emit tokens representing owning shares of premium NFTs. Fractional NFTs are a solution for anyone to own a fraction of premium NFTs, exchange their fraction on multiple DEXes (Uniswap, Pancake Swap, etc.)

Bricks relies on Layer 2 technologies for scaling.
how_its_made:
This project is using Layer 2 solutions,  Scaffold-ETH with Inferno, mostly daisyUI and chakra-ui for the front-end.

Layer 2 solutions include Polygon zkEVM, Optimism, Scroll, etc.

The NFT owner connect to this DApp and can generate ERC20 tokens which represent shares of their non fungible token (ERC721 / ERC1155).
